The sauce was right up my alley. ``` ## Review It was peak dinner hour and every restaurant nearby had a massive line. We wandered around hungry for a while before finding a ramen place with decent reviews and no wait. I was craving something spicy, so I ordered the Spicy Tonkotsu Ramen and the karaage chicken rice bowl. ```adcard ``` The ramen was decent — nothing extraordinary. It wasn't particularly memorable, but just being able to walk in without waiting during peak hour was more than enough. The rice bowl sauce was actually spot-on for my taste, so I ended up enjoying the bowl even more. The rice bowl left a stronger impression than the ramen. ## Pictures
